mobile.safety.title: Safety
mobile.safety.media_private_hint: In public rooms, where anyone can post, they wait until you tap Show.
mobile.safety.media_never_hint: They wait until you tap Show, everywhere.
mobile.safety.media_footer: Your own pictures and videos always show. Applies on all your sessions.
mobile.safety.hide_strangers_hint: From people you share no room with. They aren't declined: they stay listed here.
mobile.safety.ignored_footer: You don't see their messages or invitations. They aren't told.
mobile.safety.ignore_body: You won't see their messages or invitations on any of your sessions, earlier messages included. They aren't told.
mobile.safety.decline_ignore_body: You won't get their messages or invitations any more. They aren't told.
mobile.safety.report_message_body: Your homeserver's admins will see this report and the message.
mobile.safety.report_body: Your homeserver's admins will see this report.
